entities.summary: Raahe is a town in Finland, located on the western coast of the country. Raahe is situated in the North Ostrobothnia region, along the Gulf of Bothnia. The population of Raahe is approximately 23,000, while the sub-region has a population of approximately 31,000. It is the 43rd most populous municipality in Finland.
